notes.title: Build 1.25 [Enemy & Technical]
notes.notes:
Ahh it wasn't that easy, however I can say that we are slowly approaching the end of the chapter with Defense mode! I think two more patch updates and I'll be able to start adding the new gamemode. In this update I added 2 new enemies (bosses) Monstro and Dammer Statue. I've also added a new tab in the menu "HOW TO PLAY?" which is a tutorial for the game.

[b]What's new in this update?[/b]
-New zombie AI
-Fix zombie spawning
-Change zombie stats (HP, Damage, Speed...)
-Add new tab in menu "HOW TO PLAY?"
-Add 2 new bosses (Dammer Statue and Monstro)
-Fix Blyskawica equiping scale
-Fix G18KRM Equiping scale
-Add swipe sound to melee weapons
-Change spawned weapons size 

Keep your fingers crossed that I finish the mode as soon as possible! Have fun!

notes.title: Build 1.23 [GUI & Technical & Graphics]
notes.notes:
Hi, after a long and hard work I can finally share a new update [Build 1.23]!
The update added many systems fixes, unfortunately I had to disable the ability to earn achievements and player stats. Thus zeroing them out. This was due to the introduction of a new stats system [better secured], in the next update [Build 1.24] everything should be back.
Full list of changes you can find below!

[b]What's new in this update?[/b]
-New weapon upgrade "Magazine Capacity"

-Change weapon upgrade price

-Change player upgrade price

-Change minimum brightness value (-2 > -5)
-New aim sensitivity setting

-New volume setting (environment)
-Reduced income every five rounds (150$>50$)

-Change weapon bobbing effect
-Fix escaped flare light flashing

Develop Changes:
-Rebuild achievements system (currently deactivated)

And that's it for this update, I hope you like the added content, sooo I'm starting to do another build! See you soon!

Thanks for your patience! 🙂
~GreQu

notes.title: Build 1.21 [Technical & Achievements]
notes.notes:
Hi, after many days of work, and writing about 1.6k lines of code, I finally completed this update!
I added the ability to pick up and drop weapons, and I completely rebuilt the store system.
Now when you want to buy a weapon, you have to place an order,
after paying you get a flare which you throw out and get a supply drop!
The other big change is the change in weapon recoil, movement effect and animation !
I hope you guys enjoy the update, and now, I'm off to make another one!

[b]What's new in this update?[/b]
-Fix achievements progress on steam
-Now, you can drop and pickup weapons!
-Add more "Welcome text" in menu
-Change weapons recoil
-New walk/run/scope etc. animations
-Fix zombie blocking outside map
-Change lightning settings
-Fix discord link in menu

[b]Develop Changes[/b]
-Remake shop system
-Remake Inventory system
-Change weapon movement system

Thanks for your patience! :D
~GreQu
